deploybot: Production deploy starting: env=prod region=us-west-2 tag=release-v3.6.7 commit=6f1a2d. Strategy=gradual (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Canary window 10m. Start ts=1719998888. Watch p50/p95/p99, errors, and infra autoscale. @here :rocket:
alexander: On it. I'll watch p99 and error rate. Let me know if KV cache miss jumps. :eyes:
sam: Canary smoke passed on 10% (latency ok, no errors). Logs look clean for inference runtime.
ops_sre: FYI hold policy: auto-pause if error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 latency > 350ms sustained 2m. Manual hold allowed. Thresholds pushed to the rollout dashboard. :clipboard:
release_manager: Noting pinned model variant r3.6-quant and fallback set to r3.5-pt-ev. Added note to release notes about kernel tweak and expected perf change.
deploybot: Canary complete -> shifting to 50% now. Traffic shift started.
ops_sre: Seeing small spike in KV cache misses on pool-gpu-2, p99 up ~20ms vs baseline. Adding reaction :eyes:.
alexander: Agree we should pause at 50% and investigate for 10-15m. Manual hold recommended unless error rate stays flat.
release_manager: Approved manual hold requested by @alexander. @deploybot please pause further shifts.
deploybot: Traffic shift paused at 50% (manual hold by alexander). Rolling back further increases. Notifying autoscaler to spin up one replacement node in pool-gpu-2.
sam: Quick note from perf: observed transient mem pressure on GPU node (NVML shows ~98% mem on GPU-3) when sequence lengths spike. Reproducing with local replay.
ops_sre: Draining GPU-3 now and creating replacement instance (eta ~6m). Will tail logs and watch p99.
release_manager: Keeping the change window open an extra 15m. Documenting the hold and rationale in release notes so postmortem artifacts are collected.
alexander: Thx. If metrics steady after replacement, resume to 100% in staged increments (50->75->100) with 5m observation each.
deploybot: Replacement up. Monitor window resumed. Resuming traffic shift: moving to 75% now.
ops_sre: Metrics trending back to baseline. p99 latency back within 10ms of baseline. No errors.
sam: Running one more perf replay on pool-gpu-2, looks stable.
deploybot: Traffic shift to 100% complete. Deploy finished. Summary: tag=release-v3.6.7 commit=6f1a2d duration=00:42:37. Canary=pass, manual hold at 50% for investigation, no rollback. Post-release checklist items created. :white_check_mark:
release_manager: Noted — closing the window and updating the release notes with the hold timeline and mitigations. Will notify product and CSM.
alexander: Great run. Thanks everyone for quick response. :tada:
ops_sre: Will keep an eye on smoothing for the next 24h. Alerts configured.
sam: thx all.
